fatal_blockers: Proposal 1 is the sole selectable mutation, but its audit is prospective: strict Boolean excess, a common rational center, and exact metric-specific exclusion of every other lattice point remain unproved. Even a surviving NAND shell would not establish COPY, transfer closure, lambda/mu >= 65/64, or resistance to G28/G32/G37 under composition.

Proposal 2 is not a bounded experiment because the rational centers and metric choices are not frozen. Coset minima alone do not certify the unrestricted min-plus transfer operator, and no emitted Construction-A carry lattice is specified to substantiate the G1/G6/G7 audit.

Proposal 3 is structurally impossible. Minimizing a graph-cut energy over auxiliary vertices preserves submodularity, so legal words 001 and 110 cannot both have cost R while false words 000 and 111 both exceed R.

Proposal 4's stated three-port product has additive port energy; equal costs on the four NAND words then force each single-port truth cost to be constant, making all false words tie. Allowing cross-port trace terms would be a new, presently unfrozen family with no bounded center search.

Proposal 5 lacks metric normalization, so its absolute 1/64 margin can be manufactured by scaling Q. It also gives no finite iteration bound, compact eigenvalue bounds, fixed port/glue representation, or guaranteed rational reconstruction, so the proposed CEGIS run is not yet a bounded verifier.

Proposal 6 cannot establish its claimed broad refutation from dimensions 1 through 6 and coordinates in {-1,0,1}; its own falsification clause concedes this. A finite absence or presence of toric relations in that box neither constructs a FRONTIER tile nor proves an unbounded normal-form obstruction.
evidence: The Generation-4 verifier exactly rejects 631701504 candidates in the common-coupling D4 grid, finding a false Boolean point inside or tied in every case. That is finite evidence only and does not cover independent x,y,z couplings.

The prior Boolean identity does not kill Proposal 1: A=1 and B=C=2 makes all four false-word excesses positive. Thus the independent-coupling grid is a genuine bounded escape from the verified family rather than a relabeling of it.

For Proposal 3, submodularity gives f(001)+f(110) >= f(000)+f(111). If the two legal costs equal R, both false costs cannot be strictly greater than R; modular target potentials and auxiliary minimization do not escape this inequality.

No verifier evidence is supplied for any of the six new proposals. Their obstruction-audit assertions therefore cannot be treated as results, especially for unrestricted fibers, kernels, malformed ports, or depth-two growth.
next_experiment: Run only Proposal 1's frozen NAND-shell gate: cover all 663552 non-antipodal labelings and all 3375 triples x,y,z in {-7,...,7}/16 with a proved exact signature compression and exact positive-definiteness tests. Retain only signatures with all four false Boolean excesses strictly positive, solve the legal equal-radius center equations exactly, and for each survivor certify all-lattice emptiness by exact CVP or a complete Q-specific Voronoi-relevant-vector enumeration for (2D4*)^3; a standard-metric relevant-vector list is invalid. Kill the family if no strictly empty rational shell survives, and stop after recording survivors without claiming COPY, transfer growth, recursion, or hardness.
